descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S17 「现成的 api spec：每种 AI 调用都在总耗时旁边记服务商的耗时；在打桩的兜底上，日志和审计行写出回答的模型」 Existing api specs: every AI call kind logs the vendor's time beside the total; on a stubbed fallback the log and audit rows name the answering model

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U13 Every AI call (pre-round summary, note generation, billing, Ask AI, photo capture, handoff) logs its total time and, separately, the time the AI provider itself took, and which model answered（UAT 3.5；UAT 3.9；TFA-94514 AC 7）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given Local backend, diagnostics cleared before each kind; a logged invocation with bedrock.invoke stubbed for the fallback

When Call parsePreRoundNotes, generateNote, suggestBilling, askChart, scanCensusSheet, generateHandoff; run a stubbed Haiku -> Mistral fallback and a normal Haiku call

Then aiCallLog providerMs is a number and durationMs >= providerMs for the six kinds; the ai_disclosure audit row's provider_ms is checked for notes.generateNote only. On the stubbed fallback the log row has model Mistral, fellBackFrom Haiku, ok true, and the audit row model Mistral, fell_back_from Haiku; the normal path has model Haiku and no fellBackFrom. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright api assertions. Without vendor credentials the six kinds fail and are timed anyway, so live timing is S04 / S07 / S10 / S18 / S19. Other call types (transcription, voice fix, extraction) are Q13

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S17 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-06.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：PERF · 性能计时 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
